name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Recruitment Drive
description_md:
![S.H.I.E.L.D. Needs You!](https://i.imgur.com/w49gYbS.png)

Join S.H.I.E.L.D. today and save humanity from threats foreign and domestic.

At the start of the game, use Maria Hill's Alter-Ego ability to start with [The Circe](/card/50017). Don't mulligan anything, but say goodbye to all of those cards unless you draw a double.

Throughout the game, use Maria's _Reassignment_ ability to move counters from [Field Agent](/card/27044) and/or [Command Team](/card/23016) to [The Bellerophon](/card/50018), [The Circe](/card/50017), [The Iliad](/card/50009), and/or [The Pericles](/card/50020). Also use [Superpower Training](/card/40059) to get [S.H.I.E.L.D. Director](/card/50011) out as soon as possible. If you have to get it out first, just grab [Life Model Decoy](/card/50010); you never know when you might [need another Timmy](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wsGnYuQwsOI)! (I don't care if I already made this joke. It's funny right there).

Once you have [The Circe](/card/50017), you can play some pretty impressive allies:

- [Agent 13](/card/27046) just does so much. Two [The Iliad](/card/50009), two [Helicarriers](/card/01092), or even more [Support Staff](/card/50008) are all great.

- [Beast](/card/33011) lets you grab a resource, like [Special Funding](/card/50007), which you can use to generate even more counters on your stuff.

- You're gonna defeat side schemes, aren't you? [Cable](/card/45011) lets you draw more cards for doing so.

- [Dum Dum Dugan](/card/27047) hits like a truck. Or thwarts like... stealthy truck? Maybe I've lost the metaphor, but he's really expensive but FREEEEE with Circe, and you can exhaust all those supports you haven't used up yet to make him hit harder and stealthierer.

- [Giant-Man](/card/12012) is a massive 4 THW, 4 ATK ally that can be kept healthy with [Field Agent](/card/27044) and [Regroup](/card/19032).

- [Goliath](/card/04013) can swing out for an impressive 5 ATK, but only for the rest of the turn. With some [Command Teams](/card/23016) and [Field Agents](/card/27044), you can get a _lot_ of extra damage out of him.

- [Havok](/card/36014) is going to hit pretty hard sometimes and in doing so, take a lot of damage. Use [Field Agent](/card/27044) to help keep him around a little longer.

- [Nick Fury](/card/50002) lets you add a counter to your ships whenever he uses a basic power. If you use [Command Team](/card/23016) to ready him, he can help super-charge your counter reassignment. If you use [Field Agent](/card/27044), you can get a longer-lasting, more repeatable use of this ability. If you use both, well that's just the best of both worlds, isn't it?

**Field Manual Misc.**

- [Special Funding](/card/50007), [Reinforcements](/card/50005), and [S.H.I.E.L.D. Director](/card/50011) work on any S.H.I.E.L.D. support, not just ones with uses/counters. Don't forget that you can place counters on [Helicarrier](/card/01092)  if there's no other option and simply reassign them somewhere else later.

- You must choose 3 non-Leadership S.H.I.E.L.D. supports for this deck and include all legal copies (1 if it's unique or one-per-deck, 3 otherwise), or simply have none. I'd like to go down to 2 copies of [Field Agent](/card/27044) if I could to fin in more [Regroup](/card/19032) or [Rapid Response](/card/08031).

- [The Iliad](/card/50009) is the best ship overall. Lots of counters, lots of flexibility, looks really cool. [The Bellerophon](/card/50018) is also great for dealing with a swarm of enemies and/or tough tokens. [The Pericles](/card/50020) is great for confusing the villain, giving your allies a tough, or a high SCH minion a confuse as well. And what do you with that confuse? Flip down to Alter-Ego and go shopping for a new ship.
